newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian net foreign debt rises in June qtr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian net foreign debt rises in June qtr.

text.p: Australia's net foreign debt rose to A$187.804 billion in the June quarter from A$185.155 billion in the March quarter (revised from A$184.782 billion), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compared with net debt of A$181.972 billion a year earlier.
Gross foreign debt rose to A$235.482 billion from A$230.573 billion in the March quarter (revised from A$230.987 billion) compared with A$223.990 billion a year earlier, the bureau said.
Net Foreign Debt June Qtr 96 March Qtr 96 June Qtr 95
The Bureau said said the ratio of net foreign debt to GDP at the end of the June quarter was 38.6 percent, down from 38.8 percent. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 373-1800
